about: Per tank: trackContact.panYM (belly pan) and bottomYM in the root frame; the combat hull box min/max (x, y, z) in the hull rig frame; turretMinY, the combat turret box floor in the turret rig frame (null without a fighting turret); all in metres, as tools/gen-combat-anatomy.mjs measures them. A move over toleranceM fails the anatomy regen, its --check and npm test, naming the parts responsible. Change a row only with `node tools/anatomy-floor-drift.mjs --accept=<ids>:<reason>` (or gen-combat-anatomy --accept-floor=, or COT_ACCEPT_FLOOR_DRIFT): the row records the old values, the reason, who and when.
